widgets.description: Top app bar with title, prefix, and suffix widgets. Title takes a Widget, NOT a String.
widgets.parameters: title: Widget?, prefix: Widget?, suffix: Widget?, centerTitle: bool?, titleSpacing: double?, backgroundColor: Color?, automaticallyImplyLeading: bool = true

widgets.description: Primary filled button. Has PRIVATE default constructor — use .medium or .large ONLY.
widgets.parameters: btnText: String? (required if no child), child: Widget?, onTap: VoidCallback?, buttonType: ButtonType = ButtonType.defaultButton, iconPath: String?, suffixIconPath: String?, width: double, isLoading: bool = false, backgroundColor: Color?, textColor: Color?, borderRadius: BorderRadius?
widgets.example:
AppFilledButton.medium(
  btnText: 'Login',
  onTap: () {},
  buttonType: ButtonType.defaultButton,
  width: double.infinity,
)

AppFilledButton.large(
  btnText: 'Submit',
  onTap: () {},
  buttonType: ButtonType.successButton,
  iconPath: 'assets/svg/check.svg',
)

widgets.description: Outlined button for secondary actions. Has PRIVATE default constructor — use .medium or .large ONLY.
widgets.parameters: btnText: String? (required if no child), child: Widget?, onTap: VoidCallback?, buttonType: ButtonType = ButtonType.defaultButton, iconPath: String?, suffixIconPath: String?, width: double, isLoading: bool = false
widgets.example:
AppOutlinedButton.medium(
  btnText: 'Cancel',
  onTap: () {},
  buttonType: ButtonType.neutralButton,
  width: double.infinity,
)

widgets.description: Text-only button for tertiary actions. Has PRIVATE default constructor — use .medium or .large ONLY.
widgets.parameters: btnText: String? (required if no child), child: Widget?, onTap: VoidCallback?, buttonType: ButtonType = ButtonType.defaultButton, iconPath: String?, suffixIconPath: String?, width: double
widgets.example:
AppTextButton.medium(
  btnText: 'Forgot Password?',
  onTap: () {},
  buttonType: ButtonType.defaultButton,
)

widgets.description: Medium-emphasis tonal button. Has PRIVATE default constructor — use .medium or .large ONLY.
widgets.parameters: btnText: String? (required if no child), child: Widget?, onTap: VoidCallback?, buttonType: ButtonType = ButtonType.defaultButton, iconPath: String?, suffixIconPath: String?, width: double, isLoading: bool = false
widgets.example:
AppTonalButton.medium(
  btnText: 'Details',
  onTap: () {},
  buttonType: ButtonType.defaultButton,
)

widgets.description: Text input with label, validation, and helper text. Has PRIVATE default constructor — use .medium or .large ONLY.
widgets.parameters: labelText: String?, hintText: String?, textEditingController: TextEditingController?, keyboardType: TextInputType?, obscureText: bool = false, readOnly: bool = false, prefix: Widget?, suffix: Widget?, helperText: String?, validator: String? Function(String?)?, width: double = 200, height: double (40 for medium / 56 for large), isOptionalEnabled: bool = false, optionalText: String?, onChanged: Function(String)?
widgets.example:
AppTextField.large(
  labelText: 'Email',
  hintText: 'Enter your email',
  textEditingController: _emailController,
  keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
  width: double.infinity,
)

AppTextField.large(
  labelText: 'Password',
  hintText: 'Enter your password',
  textEditingController: _passwordController,
  obscureText: true,
  width: double.infinity,
)

widgets.description: Typography component. Has PRIVATE default constructor — MUST use named constructors: .headingMd, .headingSm, .bodyLg, .bodyLgMedium, .bodyLgSemiBold, .bodyMd, .bodyMdMedium, .bodyMdSemiBold, .bodySm, .bodySmMedium, .bodySmSemiBold, .captionLg, .captionLgMedium, .captionLgSemiBold, .captionSm, .captionSmSemiBold
widgets.parameters: text: String (REQUIRED), textColor: Color?, textAlign: TextAlign = TextAlign.start, maxLines: int?, overflow: TextOverflow?, letterSpacing: double?, height: double?, decoration: TextDecoration?
widgets.example:
AppText.headingMd(text: 'Welcome Back', textColor: TextColors.colorText)

AppText.bodyMd(text: 'Enter your credentials', textColor: TextColors.colorTextSecondary)

AppText.captionLg(text: 'Forgot password?', textColor: TextColors.colorTextLink)

widgets.description: Checkbox input with custom styling.
widgets.parameters: value: bool? (REQUIRED), onChanged: ValueChanged<bool?>?, tristate: bool = false, isError: bool = false, size: double = 20, checkmarkSize: double = 14, activeColor: Color?, checkColor: Color?
widgets.example:
AppCheckBox(
  value: _rememberMe,
  onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _rememberMe = value ?? false),
)

widgets.description: Radio button input. Generic type T for value/groupValue.
widgets.parameters: value: T (REQUIRED), groupValue: T (REQUIRED), onChanged: void Function(bool)?, borderWidth: double?, splashRadius: double?
widgets.example:
AppRadioButton<String>(
  value: 'option1',
  groupValue: selectedValue,
  onChanged: (selected) => setState(() => selectedValue = 'option1'),
)

widgets.description: Toggle switch component.
widgets.parameters: value: bool (REQUIRED), onChanged: void Function(bool)?, activeColor: Color?, activeTrackColor: Color?, inactiveTrackColor: Color?, thumbColor: Color?
widgets.example:
AppSwitch(
  value: _isEnabled,
  onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _isEnabled = value),
)

widgets.description: SVG icon renderer. Requires flutter_svg package.
widgets.parameters: svgIconPath: String (REQUIRED — must be one of AppAssets.plus / .minus / .alertCircle / .close / .check / .appLogoSvg / .back), width: double? = 16, height: double? = 16, colorFilter: ColorFilter?, onTap: VoidCallback?, fit: BoxFit = BoxFit.contain

widgets.description: Badge for status indicators and labels. Has PRIVATE default constructor — use .small or .medium ONLY.
widgets.parameters: textLabel: String?, badgeType: AppBadgeType = AppBadgeType.defaultBadge, isStrong: bool = false, svgIconPath: String?, width: double?, borderRadius: double?

AppBadge.small(
  textLabel: 'New',
  badgeType: AppBadgeType.info,
)

AppBadge.medium(
  textLabel: 'Active',
  badgeType: AppBadgeType.success,

)

widgets.description: Horizontal divider line.
widgets.parameters: color: Color? = BorderColors.colorBorderSecondary, height: double?, thickness: double?, indent: double?, endIndent: double?
widgets.example: const AppDivider()

widgets.description: Bottom sheet modal component. Requires a body Widget.
widgets.parameters: body: Widget (REQUIRED), showDragHandler: bool = true, contentPadding: EdgeInsets?, contentBackgroundColor: Color?, headerBackgroundColor: Color?, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment?, mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize?

widgets.description: Loading spinner with optional text.
widgets.parameters: color: Color?, loadingText: String?, textStyle: TextStyle?

widgets.description: Expandable/collapsible content. Requires header, body, trailingIcon, pressedColor.
widgets.parameters: header: Widget (REQUIRED), body: Widget (REQUIRED), trailingIcon: Widget? (REQUIRED), pressedColor: Color (REQUIRED), initiallyExpanded: bool = false, animationDuration: Duration?
widgets.example:
AppExpandableView(
  header: AppText.bodyMdSemiBold(text: 'Details'),
  body: Column(children: [/* content */]),
  trailingIcon: Icon(Icons.expand_more),
  pressedColor: BgColors.colorBgSurfaceSecondary,
)

widgets.description: Modal dialog with optional header, body, and footer sections.
widgets.parameters: modalHeaderTitle: String = '', bodyWidget: Widget?, footerWidget: Widget?, svgIconPath: String?, onTap: VoidCallback?, showModalHeader: bool = true, showModalHeaderTitle: bool = true, showModalHeaderIcon: bool = true, showModalHeaderDivider: bool = true, spaceBetweenTitleAndDivider: double? = 16, spaceBetweenBodyAndFooter: double? = 16

widgets.description: Sticky bottom navigation bar for screens with multiple top-level tabs (Home, Orders, Profile, etc.). Use as Scaffold.bottomNavigationBar. Each item takes a Flutter Material Icon() and a label string. Automatically applies brand colors to selected vs unselected items.
widgets.parameters: items: List<AppBottomNavigationBarItem> (REQUIRED), selectedIndex: int = 0, onTap: Function(int)?, backgroundColor: Color?, selectedItemColor: Color?, unselectedItemColor: Color?, borderColor: Color?, elevation: double?, iconSize: double = 24
widgets.example:
AppBottomNavigationBar(
  items: [
    AppBottomNavigationBarItem(icon: const Icon(Icons.home_outlined), label: 'Home'),
    AppBottomNavigationBarItem(icon: const Icon(Icons.search_outlined), label: 'Explore'),
    AppBottomNavigationBarItem(icon: const Icon(Icons.shopping_cart_outlined), label: 'Orders'),
    AppBottomNavigationBarItem(icon: const Icon(Icons.person_outline), label: 'Profile'),
  ],
  selectedIndex: _selectedIndex,
  onTap: (i) => setState(() => _selectedIndex = i),
)

widgets.description: Scrollable horizontal tab bar with customizable colors. Requires tabs (list of label strings), selectedIndex, and onTabSelected callback.
widgets.parameters: tabs: List<String> (REQUIRED), selectedIndex: int (REQUIRED), onTabSelected: ValueChanged<int> (REQUIRED), tabWidgets: List<Widget>?, activeColor: Color = Colors.black, inactiveColor: Color = BgColors.colorBgSurfaceHover, width: double? (width of EACH INDIVIDUAL TAB — do NOT use double.infinity here; omit for auto-sizing), height: double?, margin: EdgeInsetsGeometry?, paddingInside: EdgeInsetsGeometry?, textAlign: TextAlign = TextAlign.center, borderRadius: double = 8, indicatorColor: Color = AppColors.colorGray1600, borderColor: Color = BorderColors.colorBorderSecondary, activeTextColor: Color = TextColors.colorTextOnBgFill, inactiveTextColor: Color = TextColors.colorText
widgets.example:
ScrollableTabBar(
  tabs: ['All', 'Active', 'Completed'],
  selectedIndex: _selectedTab,
  onTabSelected: (index) => setState(() => _selectedTab = index),
)

widgets.description: Step progress bar indicator.
widgets.parameters: numOfSteps: int (REQUIRED), activeIndex: int (REQUIRED), activeColor: Color?, disableColor: Color?, height: double = 6, space: double = 2
widgets.example:
AppStepper(
  numOfSteps: 4,
  activeIndex: 1,
)

widgets.description: Multi-step flow with header, stepper line, and step content.
widgets.parameters: steps: List<StepView> (REQUIRED), activeIndex: int (REQUIRED), showStepperLine: bool = true, backgroundColor: Color?, icon: Widget?

StepperFlow(
  steps: [
    StepView(stepName: 'Step 1', stepBody: Widget1()),
    StepView(stepName: 'Step 2', stepBody: Widget2()),

)
